import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Queue;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {

    static class FlowEdge {
        int v, u;
        long cap, flow = 0;

        FlowEdge(int v, int u, long cap) {
            this.v = v;
            this.u = u;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        long flowInf = 1e18;
        List<FlowEdge> edges;
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int n, m = 0;
        int s, t;
        int[] level, ptr;
        Queue<Integer> q;

        Dinic(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            this.s = s;
            this.t = t;
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[n + 1];
            ptr = new int[n + 1];
            q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        }

        void add(int v, int u, long cap) {
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(v, u, cap));
            edges.add(new FlowEdge(u, v, 0));
            adj.get(v).add(edges.size() - 2);
            adj.get(u).add(edges.size() - 1);
            m += 2;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int viz : adj.get(v)) {
                    if (edges.get(viz).cap - edges.get(viz).flow < 1) continue;
                    if (level[edges.get(viz).u] != -1) continue;
                    level[edges.get(viz).u] = level[v] + 1;
                    q.add(edges.get(viz).u);
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int v, long pushed) {
            if (pushed == 0) return 0;
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            for (int &i = ptr[v]; i < adj.get(v).size(); i++) {
                int viz = adj.get(v).get(i);
                int u = edges.get(viz).u;
                if (level[v] + 1 != level[u] || edges.get(viz).cap - edges.get(viz).flow < 1) continue;
                long tr = dfs(u, Math.min(pushed, edges.get(viz).cap - edges.get(viz).flow));
                if (tr == 0) continue;
                edges.get(viz).flow += tr;
                edges.get(viz ^ 1).flow -= tr;
                return tr;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long flow() {
            long f = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(level, -1);
                level[s] = 0;
                q.add(s);
                if (!bfs()) break;
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (long pushed = dfs(s, flowInf))
                    f += pushed;
            }
            return f;
        }
    }

    static int[][] pos;
    static int[][] matTempo;
    static int[][] matAlc;
    static String[] sc;
    static int n, t, n2, nMax, iZ, jZ;

    static List<Pair> pegaVizinhos(int i, int j, String[] mat, int n) {
        List<Pair> viz = new ArrayList<>();
        if (i + 1 < n) viz.add(new Pair(i + 1, j));
        if (i - 1 >= 0) viz.add(new Pair(i - 1, j));
        if (j + 1 < n) viz.add(new Pair(i, j + 1));
        if (j - 1 >= 0) viz.add(new Pair(i, j - 1));
        return viz;
    }

    static void criaMatTempo(int i, int j, String[] sc, int n, int currT) {
        if (i >= n || i < 0 || j >= n || j < 0 || (!Character.isDigit(sc[i].charAt(j)) && sc[i].charAt(j) != 'Z') || (matTempo[i][j] != -1 && matTempo[i][j] <= currT)) return;
        if (matTempo[i][j] == -1)
            matTempo[i][j] = currT;
        else
            matTempo[i][j] = Math.min(currT, matTempo[i][j]);
        criaMatTempo(i + 1, j, sc, n, currT + 1);
        criaMatTempo(i - 1, j, sc, n, currT + 1);
        criaMatTempo(i, j + 1, sc, n, currT + 1);
        criaMatTempo(i, j - 1, sc, n, currT + 1);
    }

    static void criaMatAlc(int i, int j, String[] sc, int n, int currT) {
        if (i >= n || i < 0 || j >= n || j < 0 || (matAlc[i][j] != -1 && matAlc[i][j] <= currT) || !Character.isDigit(sc[i].charAt(j))) return;
        if (matAlc[i][j] == -1)
            matAlc[i][j] = currT;
        else
            matAlc[i][j] = Math.min(currT, matAlc[i][j]);
        criaMatAlc(i + 1, j, sc, n, currT + 1);
        criaMatAlc(i - 1, j, sc, n, currT + 1);
        criaMatAlc(i, j + 1, sc, n, currT + 1);
        criaMatAlc(i, j - 1, sc, n, currT + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        n2 = n * n;
        nMax = n2 * 2;
        Dinic grafo = new Dinic(nMax + 2, 0, nMax + 1);
        sc = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            sc[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        pos = new int[n][n];
        matTempo = new int[n][n];
        matAlc = new int[n][n];
        int cnt = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                pos[i][j] = cnt;
                cnt++;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (sc[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    iZ = i;
                    jZ = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String caps = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(caps.charAt(j))) {
                    grafo.add(0, pos[i][j], caps.charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        Arrays.fill(matTempo, -1);
        criaMatTempo(iZ, jZ, sc, n, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (matTempo[i][j] == -1 && Character.isDigit(sc[i].charAt(j))) matTempo[i][j] = t;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Arrays.fill(matAlc, -1);
                if (Character.isDigit(sc[i][j])) {
                    int lmt = sc[i][j] - '0';
                    grafo.add(pos[i][j], n2 + pos[i][j], lmt);
                    criaMatAlc(i, j, sc, n, 0);
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                            if (matAlc[k][l] != -1 && matTempo[k][l] != -1 && matAlc[k][l] <= matTempo[k][l] && matAlc[k][l] <= t) {
                                boolean crt = true;
                                if (matAlc[k][l] == matTempo[k][l]) {
                                    crt = false;
                                    if (k + 1 < n && matAlc[k + 1][l] != -1 && matAlc[k + 1][l] < matTempo[k + 1][l]) crt = true;
                                    if (k - 1 >= 0 && matAlc[k - 1][l] != -1 && matAlc[k - 1][l] < matTempo[k - 1][l]) crt = true;
                                    if (l + 1 < n && matAlc[k][l + 1] != -1 && matAlc[k][l + 1] < matTempo[k][l + 1]) crt = true;
                                    if (l - 1 >= 0 && matAlc[k][l - 1] != -1 && matAlc[k][l - 1] < matTempo[k][l - 1]) crt = true;
                                }
                                if (crt) {
                                    grafo.add(n2 + pos[i][j], n2 + pos[k][l], lmt);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(sc[i].charAt(j))) {
                    grafo.add(n2 + pos[i][j], nMax + 1, sc[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        long ans = grafo.flow();
        pw.println(ans);
        pw.close();
    }

    static class Pair {
        int x, y;

        Pair(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }
